item.title: Hiker dies after fall on steep, snowy mountain near Lions Bay, B.C.
item.description: A man who slipped and fell about 100 metres while trying to help a companion during a hike on one of the tallest mountains on Metro Vancouver's North Shore has died of his injuries.

item.title: Flight attendant thrown from Air Canada plane survives in a ‘total miracle’
item.description: A flight attendant still strapped in her seat survived being thrown from an Air Canada plane that collided with a fire truck at New York's LaGuardia Airport, her daughter said Monday.

item.title: New York plane crash investigation looking at cockpit recorder and controllers
item.description: Investigators looking into the collision between an Air Canada jet and a fire truck at New York’s LaGuardia Airport are reviewing the cockpit voice recorder and what was happening inside the control tower moments before the crash.

item.title: Liberals to debate age restrictions on social media, AI chatbots
item.description: Age restrictions on using social media accounts and AI chatbots are among the topics up for debate when Liberal party grassroots gather next month for their national convention.

item.title: Pride festivals seek federal $3M as corporations pull back support amid DEI backlash
item.description: Pride festivals are seeking $3 million annually from Ottawa to fill a funding gap left by organizers pulling back funding amid a backlash to diversity, equity and inclusion programs.

item.title: Manitoba Premier promises to end provincial tax on food from grocery store
item.description: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says today’s budget will take the tax off food from the grocery store.

item.title: Man shot and killed at homeless encampment in Abbotsford, B.C.
item.description: Police in British Columbia's Fraser Valley are investigating after a fatal shooting at a homeless encampment.

item.title: Epic Games lays off more than 1,000 amid slowing Fortnite engagement
item.description: Fortnite publisher Epic Games said Tuesday it is laying off 1,000 employees to save money as it grapples with industry-wide and company-specific challenges.
